data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns that are commensurate with the performance of the BSE SENSEX Index, subject to tracking errors. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved
data.asset_allocation: Securities covered by the BSE SENSEX Index (TRI): 95%-100%; Debt Securities & Money Market Instruments but excluding subscription and redemption cash flow: 0%-5% ; For detailed asset allocation, refer Scheme Information Document (SID) available on the website.
data.fund_managers: FM 1 - Ms. Nandita Menezes, FM 2 - Mr.Arun Agarwal
data.exit_load: In respect of each purchase /switch-in of Units, an Exit Load of 0.25% is payable if Units are redeemed/ switched-out within 3 days from the date of allotment.No Exit Load is payable if Units are redeemed / switched-out after 3 days from the date of allotment.
